Key Remediation & Quality Fixes Implemented

  • Operator Modal Instant Activation: Removed blocking network calls during modal invocation. The Operator Account dialog now pops up with 0ms visual delay while session checklists load asynchronously.
  • Link Generator Background Blur Normalization: Calibrated generic pre-land templates to conform to the standard 0-32px blur curve with a transform: scale(1.04) border clip, eliminating visual edge artifacts.
  • Live Preview Debounce Filter: Implemented a 140ms debounce timer on real-time preview iframe requests to prevent API hammering during slider adjustments.
